stages.user_reply:
Seems fine. Blocks when placed on grass should replace the grass, not place it on top.

Also ensure Netherite knockback mitigation matches 26.3
stages.interpretation: Core gameplay confirmed with requested corrections.

stages.requested: Rejoin both clients; short/tall grass replacement and Netherite mitigation with accepted unarmored feel.
stages.user_reply:
Yup. Now the rest needs to be done.

Also some things like placing a block on top of a grass block then breaking causes that packet to be dropped. Taking an armor off your set then clicking it inside your inventory causes it to not actually go inside you inventory, etc. Sometimes blocks don't break.

These are simple things that can be fixed.

Lesson: Just because a client accepts a rule does not mean the server must not accept it. Within reason, it should. Yes it's why hacked clients work, but at the same time it makes the game more playable.
